_about: ElevenLabs voice trial (2026-11-14): three options per speaker, heard against the current OpenAI voice before anything changes in cast.json. `library` options are ElevenLabs voice-library voices read with eleven_v3; `design` speakers get three voices from one ElevenLabs Voice Design call (eleven_ttv_v3, the seed keeps it repeatable), whose generated ids are saved after you pick one. Made by scripts/voice-audition-eleven.mjs.

ji.title: Mom
lines: Look! The sky is turning pink!
Shall we go to the mall?
It's too full! Sit on it!

library.name: Anna
library.about: Thai woman, English with a Thai accent, clear and natural

library.name: Hammy
library.about: native Thai speaker, warm and friendly

saltaunty.title: Pa Kluea, the salt aunty (pony)
lines: Sawasdee ka! I'm Pa Kluea. I make the salt!
Oh no! My salt jar is empty!
Will you be my salt carrier?

design.description: A chubby, funny Thai aunty in her fifties from a mountain village in northern Thailand, speaking English with a warm northern Thai accent. Kind and playful with a twinkle in her voice and a little giggle, a bit of a tease, talking to a five-year-old in a cartoon.

kwai.title: Lung Kwai, the noodle-soup buffalo
lines: Blehh! My soup tastes like puddle water!
And the village dinner is tonight!

design.description: A big, jolly Thai uncle in his sixties, a deep booming warm voice that laughs from the belly, a bit dramatic about his cooking. Speaks English with a northern Thai accent. A cartoon water buffalo character talking to a five-year-old.

kai.title: Pa Kai, the salty-egg hen
lines: Bawk! My salty eggs aren't salty!
Now my eggs will be salty!

design.description: A cheerful, busy Thai auntie in her forties who sells salted eggs at a village market. Quick, bright, slightly high voice, a little flustered when worried and delighted when things go right. Speaks English with a northern Thai accent, like a funny animated movie character.

nak.title: Yai Nak, the otter grandma
lines: And my fish is so... plain.

design.description: A sweet old Thai grandmother in her eighties, slow, gentle and a little wobbly, with a soft giggle, calls everyone dear. Speaks English with a northern Thai accent. A cartoon otter grandma character talking to a five-year-old.
